anti_patterns.name: repeated_three_card_layout
anti_patterns.signal: More than three adjacent slides use the same three-card composition.
anti_patterns.fix: Change proof objects: chart+table, matrix+rules, timeline+ledger, bridge+callout.

anti_patterns.name: fixed_bottom_so_what_box
anti_patterns.signal: Every slide has the same bottom insight box regardless of content.
anti_patterns.fix: Place implication near the relevant proof object or remove if redundant.

anti_patterns.name: empty_chapter_divider
anti_patterns.signal: Chapter slide contains only a title and large whitespace.
anti_patterns.fix: Add chapter claim, evidence objects, and expected output.

anti_patterns.name: table_without_judgment
anti_patterns.signal: Main slide is a raw table with no highlighting or implication.
anti_patterns.fix: Sort, highlight, add conclusion title, and explain management meaning.
